steps.title: Order Confirmed
steps.desc: Your order is confirmed and processing begins.

steps.title: Procurement & Processing
steps.desc: The order is sourced, inspected, packaged, and prepared for dispatch.

steps.title: Dispatch
steps.desc: The parcel is handed to the logistics provider. Tracking activation may take 24–72 hours.

steps.title: Tracking Available
steps.desc: You receive a tracking number by email. Use it on the carrier's website to monitor progress.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.desc: The parcel is delivered to the destination address.
